responses.value: Expand, but put the new lockers in apartment buildings. Apartment lockers are 85% full while store lockers are 30% full, and at 80% full an $8,000 locker earns $2,500 a year, paying back in about 3 years. Building owners have offered 2,500 sites. The risk is that newer buildings fill more slowly, so start with 500 sites and track fill rates.
